Name: i need more farmland - more areas
Author: wrefn
Description:
[size=4]i made this because i started with a farm that didn't have enough space. i did my very best in the three days it took to make this. [/size]

[size=4]Please notify me of any issues!!![/size]

[size=4][b]installation[/b][/size]
extract and put into your mods folder. Don't forget the requirements

[b]safe [/b]to uninstall if you remove your items from the maps beforehand

[size=4][b]features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#999999]An extra area that leads to a large shed[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Large shed area in which you can place casks. Decoratable.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]A sunroom attic[/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Both outdoor areas function as greenhouses similar to [u]Ginger Island[/u] - scarecrows aren't needed (afaik).[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]i was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] but failed to actually make it an indoor farm lol.[/size]

Manifest.Name: i need more land
Manifest.Description: outdoor greenhouse(s), a caskable shed, and a sunroom
